title: I Let the Bus Driver Keep Exact Change When He Needed a Twenty

parts.text: The farebox sign said EXACT CHANGE ONLY. I had two singles and coins. A driver waved me back because he wanted my twenty for his own coffee and promised to make change later. I was forty-one, early shift. I said the sign said exact. He sighed like I had personally invented inflation. I paid exact. At the next stop he asked a tourist for a twenty to break. The tourist had a twenty. I watched the farebox eat nothing of it. I reported the coffee-float to transit. They reminded him about the sign. I kept my twenty for actual coffee. Exact is a closed system. Drivers are not ATMs. The bus still smelled like wet coats. I sat anyway.

social.video_title: He wanted my twenty for coffee under an exact-change sign — Part 1/1
social.description: Singles, coins, a sigh, a tourist ATM. Would you have handed the twenty to keep the line moving?
